caption: The drawing depicts a single, large teapot or pitcher centrally positioned on a plain background. The object has a domed lid with a finial on top, which is ornate and rounded. The body is tall, cylindrical at the base, and slightly tapers inward before flaring out at the top. The spout is wide and curves outward sharply from the upper left side, while the handle is elaborate with decorative curves, placed on the right side. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, using careful shading to suggest a metallic texture, likely silver or pewter. The background is light beige, showing some brown discoloration or staining, particularly along the left edge and lower left area. There are no other objects present in the drawing.
title: Pewter Coffee Urn
